title: Anna's Bread
text:
Anna likes to make bread. The recipe is easy. First, she mixes flour, water and salt in a big bowl. Then she waits one hour for the bread to grow.

After one hour, Anna puts the bread in the oven. The bread is ready in thirty minutes. It smells very good, and Anna eats it with her family.

questions.text: What does Anna like to make?
How long does the bread take to be ready in the oven?
How does Anna probably feel about her bread?
Why does Anna wait one hour after she mixes the ingredients?
options: so she can clean the kitchen
so the oven can cool down
so she can call her family

vocabulary.definition: a food made from flour and water, baked in an oven
a set of instructions for cooking a food
a white powder made from grain, used to make bread and cakes
a closed box used to cook or bake food

paragraph_translations: Anna gosta de fazer pão. A receita é fácil. Primeiro, ela mistura farinha, água e sal em uma tigela grande. Depois, ela espera uma hora para o pão crescer.
Depois de uma hora, Anna coloca o pão no forno. O pão fica pronto em trinta minutos. Ele tem um cheiro muito bom, e Anna o come com a família.
